records.title: Dispatch Loom
records.subtitle: Dispatch reconciliation tool
records.summary: Internal dispatch-desk reconciliation tool for mismatched references, where operators compared an overnight spreadsheet with a daily export. Personally built with Python and SQL, with a Python parser and SQL checks, and used Git and PostgreSQL. Supervisors wanted understandable exceptions; the team preferred visible warnings for late source files and kept empty rows visible. The supervisor made final dispatch decisions. The reported improvement was a team result, not solely attributable to Ada.
